stem: The reader can conclude from this line that the commentator —

options.label: B
options.text: was not expecting Pete to make so many mistakes

options.label: C
options.text: is concerned that Angie was not able to catch Pete’s mistakes on film

options.label: D
options.text: knows that people did not notice Pete’s mistakes

visual_elements: COMMENTATOR: [From offstage.] Okay . . . um . . . thank you, Pete Mahoney, for that . . . And now the referee will get ready for the coin toss. [Voice fades.]
